title: Payoff Desk Note: Span of a Re-Filed Extension Request by Sale Evidence in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Rule.** For a further extension request re-filed on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the span the request asks to cover is measured from the current resolution deadline. It follows the sale evidence on the loan's payoff file, which is the loan's Payoff and Loan Satisfaction record:

1. **Issued payoff terms with a good-through date.** Where the loan has a payoff case whose terms are issued with a statement good-through date, the span runs to that good-through date.
2. **Accepted purchase contract only.** Where there is no such statement but an accepted purchase contract is on the payoff file, the span runs to 45 calendar days after the day that contract was received. Where more than one accepted contract is on file, the one received most recently is used.
3. **Neither.** Otherwise the span is the plan's extension days.

A span that would end before the current resolution deadline is zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; current resolution deadline 1 October)

| Payoff file shows | Span |
|---|---|
| issued terms good through 30 October | 29 days |
| issued terms good through 20 September | 0 (ends before the deadline) |
| no issued terms; accepted contract received 1 September | to 16 October: 15 days |
| no issued terms; accepted contract received 1 August | 45 days after is 15 September, before the deadline: 0 |
| neither | the plan's extension days |
